Present : Senator Jim Carlson - Chair, Senator Bonnie S. Westlin Vice Chair, Senator Bruce D. Anderson, Senator Calvin K. Bahr, Senator Liz Boldon, Senator Steve A. Cwodzinski, Senator Gene Dornink, Senator Mark W. Koran, Senator Warren Limmer, Senator John Marty, Senator Andrew Mathews, Senator Nicole Mitchell, Senator Lindsey Port, Senator Ann H. Rest
 Absent : No Members Absent
 Senator Jim Carlson called the meeting to order at 3:08 PM.
 Call to order 
 S.F. 1548: Senator Rest: A delete everything amendment will replace the current language with ongoing 
funding for local governments for expenses directly related to administering 
elections. 
 Testifiers: 
 Senator Rest
 Michelle Clasen, Washington County Commissioner, Association of Minnesota Counties
 Michael Stalberger, Property and Environmental Resources Director, Blue Earth County
 (zoom) Cathy Sorensen, City Clerk, City of Blaine
 Minnesota Secretary of State Steve Simon
 Senator Rest moved the A2 Author's Amendment. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed, and the A2 Author's Amendment was adopted.
 Senator Rest moved the A3 Amendment. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed, and that A3 Amendment was adopted.
 Senator Rest moved that SF 1548, as amended, be recommended to pass, and re-referred to the Taxes Committee. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed.
Senator Rest moved that S.F. 1548, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Taxes Committee. - MOTION PREVAILED .
 S.F. 2051: Senator Boldon: Lobbying provisions expansion to include all political subdivisions. 
 Testifiers: 
 Senator Boldon
 Jeff Sigurdson, Executive Director, Minnesota Campaign Finance Board
 Senator Boldon moved the A1 Author's Amendment. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed, and the A1 Author's Amendment was adopted.
 Senator Koran moved the A2 Amendment and requested a roll call and a roll call was granted.
 Senator Carlson - nay
 Senator Westlin - nay
 Senator Koran - yay
 Senator Anderson - yay
 Senator Bahr - pass
 Senator Boldon - nay
 Senator Cwodzinski - nay
 Senator Dornink - yay
 Senator Limmer - yay
 Senator Marty - nay
 Senator Mathews - yay
 Senator Mitchell - nay
 Senator Port - nay
 Senator Rest - nay
 By a roll call vote of 5 yays, 8 nays, and 1 pass, the motion failed, and the A2 Amendment was not adopted.
 Senator Carlson moved that SF 2051, as amended, be laid over. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed.
Senator Carlson moved that S.F. 2051, as amended, laid over for possible inclusion in the omnibus bill. - MOTION PREVAILED .
 The meeting was adjourned at 4:30 PM.
Senator Jim Carlson, Chair
Taylor Spreeman, Legislative Assistant
